description: Flat strategy inputs accepted by the Chess Raiders standard bot. Bounds are author choices for this bot, not competition resource limits.

safety.description: Weight assigned to avoiding threatened destinations.

tempo.description: Weight assigned to command charge time.

targetLock.description: Weight assigned to escaping an active target lock.

moralePush.description: Weight assigned to a safe morale advance.

beaconAggression.description: How much the bot values Beacon actions (hand-off, deploy, restore) - the tier-side permission AND appetite in one 0-1 dial. Zero disables every Beacon proposal; the match rules' own beacon.enabled still gates independently, so a weight never authorises what the rules forbid.

delivery.description: Weight assigned to bringing captives home.

prisoner.description: Weight assigned to retaining a captured piece.

system.description: Weight assigned to enabled Chess Raiders system actions.

candidateSpread.description: Maximum ranked destinations retained per considered unit; zero retains all.

passBelow.description: Minimum score required before the bot issues a command.

breadth.description: Maximum ranked units considered on the 64-cell board; zero considers all.

advancedTraining.description: Whether the bot pursues advanced specialist training.

contestEnemyWork.description: Whether the bot may dismantle enemy fortifications.

sergeantPreference.description: Extra score for work supported by a sergeant.
